rules: Same joint pair/shape exclusion. Four gains scaled by training-only IQR (floor1e-6). Euclidean nearest training state, ties by source/state identity. Diagnostic support threshold=q95 of each training state's distance to nearest DIFFERENT-PAIR training state. Heldout truth used only to evaluate oracle-model disagreement and transferred neighbour model risk, never distance/scales/threshold. No selector refit, no automatic fallback or production change.
limitations: Feature-space audit only: near does not prove identifiability, far is not a calibrated probability or definitive OOD label. Oracle-model ties follow fixed order; disagreements can have tiny risk gaps. Nearest-neighbour transfer is a diagnostic, not a selected deployable algorithm. Four reused pairs, synthetic structures, known location, oracle noise calibration; no independent final validation.
